newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends steady vs dlr/mark basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends steady vs dlr/mark basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket on Wednesday and was slightly weaker against the dollar as the U.S. unit firmed versus the mark, dealers said.
The forint finished at 196.49/54 to the dollar, compared to 196.35/40 at opening and 196.42/47 at midday.
The forint remained stuck at the central bank's resistance level after it closed a six or seven pip gap shortly after the start of morning trade, they said.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5-percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
